name: ERC Starting Grant (ERC-2027-StG)
eligibility: 0–10 yrs post-PhD (window widened in the 2027 Work Programme; was 2–7)
amount: Up to EUR 1.5M (+ up to EUR 1M extra for start-up/equipment/relocation)
deadline_note: ERC-2027-StG opened 22 Jul 2026 and closes 14 Oct 2026 (official ERC page). The next call (ERC-2028-StG) will probably close around Oct 2027, but it has not been announced.
notes: This is the flagship independence grant for a metascience/AI-safety agenda and can be held in any EU or associated country, including the UK. The 2027 Work Programme adds limits on how many proposals one person can submit, so if the Oct 2026 deadline is too close, it is probably better to aim for the 2028 call than to submit a rushed proposal.

name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (European / Global)
eligibility: PhD + <8 yrs FTE research experience since PhD; mobility rule (must not have lived/worked in the host country >12 months in the 36 months before the deadline)
duration: European PF 12–24 months; Global PF 12–24 months outgoing + 12-month return phase
amount: Living, mobility and family allowances (country-adjusted) plus research, training and management costs
deadline_note: The 2026 call closed 9 Sep 2026. The 2027 call is listed as 7 Apr – 8 Sep 2027, but the MSCA site marks these dates as indicative/TBC.
notes: A very good fit for a 2-year European postdoc with a chosen supervisor, and UK hosts are eligible. The Global PF strand requires EU nationality or long-term residence. Host universities often set internal support or review deadlines in the summer.

name: MSCA COFUND postdoctoral programmes (institution-run)
eligibility: Varies by programme; typically ≤8 yrs post-PhD plus the MSCA mobility rule
deadline_note: Each programme runs its own calls. The 2026 COFUND round funded 14 new postdoctoral schemes, whose calls will open over 2026–27. Search EURAXESS for current deadlines.
notes: These are bottom-up fellowships at large EU universities and institutes, usually open to all disciplines. Deadlines are scattered through the year, so set up a EURAXESS alert.

name: UKRI Future Leaders Fellowships (Round 12)
eligibility: Researchers establishing or transitioning to independence; no fixed post-PhD window; must be hosted by an eligible UK organisation
amount: Up to ~£1.4M guideline for the first 4 years (80% FEC)
deadline_note: Round 11 closed 16 Jun 2026. UKRI has not yet pre-announced Round 12, which is expected to open in early 2027 with a UKRI deadline around mid-June 2027 (Reading's provisional timeline says 15 Jun 2027). University internal EoIs are due around mid-Jan 2027.
notes: This is the best UK route to an independent 7-year position, and it covers interdisciplinary AI safety and metascience. Host universities cap submissions and run competitive internal sifts from Sep 2026 to Jan 2027, so you need to find a UK host now.

name: Royal Society University Research Fellowship
eligibility: 3–8 yrs research experience since PhD award (at the deadline)
deadline_note: The 2027 round closed 9 Sep 2026. The next round will probably open around Jul 2027 with a Sep 2027 deadline, but you will not have 3 years post-PhD until about 2028.
notes: An excellent scheme, but you are not yet eligible: 3+ years post-PhD are required. Revisit it for the 2028–29 rounds.

name: Newton International Fellowship
eligibility: Non-UK citizens currently based outside the UK; PhD by the deadline; ≤5 yrs active postdoc experience
amount: Up to £280,000 (salary, research expenses, relocation, visa)
deadline_note: The 2026 round ran 15 Jan – 11 Mar 2026. The 2027 round is expected on a similar timetable (Jan–Mar 2027), but its dates are not published yet.
notes: Designed for exactly your situation: a non-UK researcher abroad (CMU) moving to a UK host. The Royal Society covers the natural sciences and the British Academy covers humanities and social sciences (philosophy of science, metascience). You are ineligible if you hold UK citizenship.

name: Leverhulme Early Career Fellowship
eligibility: Doctoral thesis submitted ≤4 yrs before the closing date; no prior permanent academic post; UK degree or UK employment (Edinburgh PhD qualifies)
amount: 50% of salary from the Trust (the host matches the rest) + up to £6,000/yr research expenses
deadline_note: The 2027 round closes 4pm, 18 Feb 2027, per the Univ. of Liverpool and UCL pages; the Leverhulme site itself blocked automated access. Internal EoIs fall in Nov–Dec 2026 (Liverpool: 2 Nov 2026).
notes: Open to any discipline and well suited to philosophy of science, metascience or AI epistemics. Because the host must co-fund 50%, departments ration their endorsements through early internal deadlines.

name: British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowship (2026-27 round)
eligibility: Viva passed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 (2026-27 round)
deadline_note: The British Academy deadline is 30 Sep 2026, 17:00 BST, per the QMUL/Oxford pages (the BA site blocked automated access). University internal deadlines (Jul–Aug 2026) have already passed.
notes: A strong fit for philosophy of science, metascience and the social study of AI. This round is effectively missed. The 2027-28 round should open around summer 2027 and you should still be inside its viva window, so check that the dates line up.

name: Royal Academy of Engineering Research Fellowship
eligibility: PhD ≤4.5 yrs before the EoI deadline; UK host
amount: Up to £800,000 from the Academy (80% FEC; ~£1M total project)
deadline_note: The 2026/27 EoI closed 25 Jun 2026, and full applications (invited only) are due around Dec 2026. The 2027/28 EoI will probably run May–Jun 2027, but its dates are not published.
notes: The engineering remit suits the XAI and multi-agent systems side of your work better than the philosophy side. Many universities hold internal selection rounds before the EoI.

name: EPSRC Fellowships (postdoctoral / open)
eligibility: Postdoctoral level: early career; Open: any career stage with a PhD
duration: Up to 3 years (postdoctoral) / up to 5 years (open)
deadline_note: EPSRC is reworking its fellowships. UKRI says new opportunities will appear on its funding finder during 2026, and no dated call has been published.
notes: The AI & robotics and ICT themes cover technical XAI and AI safety. Track the UKRI funding finder for the relaunched scheme.

name: ESRC New Investigator Grants
eligibility: Early-career researchers (self-justified); must not have led a UKRI grant before (fellowships excepted); UK host + named mentor
deadline_note: The current opportunity closes 4 Nov 2026, 16:00 UK time (UKRI page).
notes: Suits social-science metascience of AI, but social science must be >50% of the project. You need a UK host willing to employ you, which is hard to arrange by November, so plan for a later round.

name: UKRI / UK Metascience Unit AI Metascience Early Career Fellowships
funder: UKRI Metascience Unit (with Sloan Foundation & SSHRC)
eligibility: PhD by the start date; no previously led external grants; UK host (2025 round)
deadline_note: The 2025 round (Feb–Apr 2025) funded 29 fellows. No new call has been announced.
notes: Almost exactly matches your agenda (AI's epistemic impact on science). Watch the UK Metascience Unit for a second cohort. The related Metascience Research Grants round two reportedly closed in Apr 2026.

name: UK Metascience Unit Metascience Research Grants
eligibility: Researchers at UK organisations (international partners allowed)
deadline_note: Round two reportedly opened 12 Feb 2026 and closed 23 Apr 2026 (I did not open the official page). Round three is not announced.
notes: A project grant rather than a fellowship, but it closely matches metascience of AI. Useful as co-I or PI once you have a UK post.

name: Turing AI Global Fellowships
funder: EPSRC / UKRI (with the Alan Turing Institute)
eligibility: Established international AI leaders or those with outstanding potential; based outside the UK ≥24 months
deadline_note: The 2026 call (EoI 9 Jan, close 12 Mar 2026) is closed and no new round has been announced. The Turing AI Pioneer fellowships were invite-only.
notes: Aimed at far more senior researchers. Listed for completeness: the Turing Institute does not currently run an open early-career fellowship.

name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards
eligibility: ≤3 yrs postdoc experience; host in the UK/Ireland (from 29 Oct 2026: UK plus selected LMICs)
deadline_note: Rolling: no fixed deadlines, with shortlisting three times a year (Feb/Jun/Sep). The current round opened 25 Aug 2026.
notes: Open to any discipline if the project bears on human health or wellbeing. Metascience and research integrity could qualify with a health-research framing. Irish hosts drop out of eligibility after 29 Oct 2026.

name: Philip Leverhulme Prize
eligibility: Nominated; UK-based researchers early in their careers (roughly within 10 yrs of PhD)
deadline_note: Nomination-only. The 2026 round closed 14 May 2026, and 2027 dates have not been checked.
notes: A prize for researchers already recognised internationally, and you need a UK institution to nominate you. Unrealistic until you have a UK post and a larger record.

name: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Postdocs
eligibility: PhD ≤4 yrs before application; non-German researchers (Germany residence limits apply)
amount: EUR 3,000/month + family, travel and language allowances
deadline_note: Three call windows a year, opening 15 Mar / 15 Jul / 15 Nov. The next opens 15 Nov 2026, and each window closes as soon as it reaches 800 applications, so apply early.
notes: A flexible, prestigious German postdoc with a self-chosen host (e.g., MPI for Human Development, Tübingen). It is a stipend rather than a faculty-track grant. Windows can fill within days.

name: DFG Emmy Noether Programme
eligibility: Normally ≤4 yrs after PhD; ≥2 yrs postdoc experience; substantial international experience
amount: Own group-leader salary + team and project costs
deadline_note: Rolling: proposals can be submitted any time. A special 'Methods in AI' Emmy Noether call closed its draft stage 10 Jun 2026.
notes: The German route to an independent junior group, and your UK and US experience counts as international. Apply from about 2027, once you have 2 years of postdoc experience. Foreign applicants must intend to continue their career in Germany.

name: DFG Walter Benjamin Programme
eligibility: Early postdoctoral phase; must change institution
amount: Postdoc position in Germany + direct project costs
deadline_note: Rolling: proposals can be submitted any time.
notes: A good bridge into a German host lab. The 'abroad' module requires 3+ years of prior research in Germany, but the Germany-based position module does not.

name: Zukunftskolleg Postdoctoral Fellowship
eligibility: PhD awarded 30 Sep 2024 – 1 Oct 2026
deadline_note: Closes 12 Oct 2026, 11:00 CET (official Zukunftskolleg page).
notes: An interdisciplinary institute for independent early-career fellows, and Konstanz is strong in collective behaviour and complex social dynamics. You must name two local hosts and live in or near Konstanz.

name: Navigating a Transforming World Order: Fellowships on Security and Technology
eligibility: ≤5 yrs post-PhD; affiliated with a German institution
deadline_note: No open call at present. Earlier rounds had results in mid-Aug 2026. Monitor the Foundation's calls; its 'AI and the Society of the Future' initiative has ended.
notes: The topics include AI in security and its ethics. A good fit if your AI-safety work is framed around societal and security risks. Requires a German host.

name: SNSF Ambizione (final call)
eligibility: ≤4 yrs post-PhD, ≥12 months postdoc research; Swiss link required (nationality, Swiss degree, or 12+ months research in Switzerland)
deadline_note: Closes 3 Nov 2026, 17:00 CET. This is the last Ambizione call; a new scheme launches in 2028.
notes: Probably ineligible without a Swiss connection. Worth checking only if you have one.

name: SNSF Starting Grants
eligibility: 2–8 yrs post-PhD; ≥2 yrs research in Switzerland (no exceptions)
amount: Up to CHF 1M project funds + own salary
deadline_note: The 2026 call closed 5 May 2026, and the 2027 call has not been published.
notes: The Swiss-residence requirement rules you out for now. It becomes relevant only after about 2 years of research in Switzerland, for example via an ETH fellowship.

name: ETH Zurich Postdoctoral Fellowship
eligibility: PhD ≤2 yrs before the submission deadline; ≥1 peer-reviewed publication; not in Switzerland >12 months in the last 3 years
amount: Full ETH postdoc salary + CHF 12,000/yr research budget
deadline_note: Fixed deadlines every year: 1 Mar and 1 Sep, 17:00 Swiss time (ETH Grants Office). 1 Sep 2026 has passed, so the next is 1 Mar 2027. This is a standing rule, not a dated 2027 call page.
notes: Well suited if you can find an ETH host (e.g., the ETH AI Center, CSS or philosophy groups). The host professor submits and can back only one candidate per round. The 2-year PhD cutoff may make Mar 2027 your last chance.

name: NWO Talent Programme Veni (Science / SSH)
eligibility: PhD ≤3 yrs before the call's reference date (2026 round: 1 Jan 2026)
deadline_note: The 2026 pre-proposal deadline (1 Sep 2026) has passed; invited full proposals are due 26 Jan 2027. 2027-round dates are not published, but going by 2026 the pre-proposal deadline should fall around Sep 2027.
notes: Prestigious and open to non-Dutch applicants, and the SSH and Science domains both suit you. A Dutch host must provide an embedding guarantee at pre-proposal stage. Check that your PhD date falls inside the 2027 window.

name: Swedish Research Council Starting Grant
eligibility: >2 and ≤7 yrs post-PhD at the deadline; Swedish host employment ≥50%
deadline_note: The 2026 Natural & Engineering Sciences window was 4 Mar – 14 Apr 2026. 2027 dates are expected in VR's November 'call year' announcement.
notes: You will not reach 2 years post-PhD before the likely spring-2027 deadline, so this is realistic from about 2028 with a Swedish host.

name: WASP-HS Postdoctoral Scholarships (MIT/Stanford with Swedish return)
funder: Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program – Humanity and Society
eligibility: Recent PhD in humanities/social sciences on AI & society (check the call for Sweden-related eligibility)
duration: 1–2 yrs abroad + 1–2 yrs repatriation support at a Swedish university
deadline_note: Several MIT and Stanford scholarship calls close 16 Nov 2026 (WASP-HS calls page). A project call with WASP closed 17 Jun 2026.
notes: A direct match for AI & society, and the programme leads into a Swedish position. But you would spend the first years in the US again, and the scholarships appear aimed at people returning to Swedish universities, so check eligibility.

name: Villum Young Investigator
eligibility: 2–8 yrs post-PhD; Danish university; technical/natural sciences
deadline_note: One call a year with a June deadline (2026 closed 3 Jun 2026). The 2027 date is unannounced.
notes: Only technical and natural sciences, and you would be at the 2-year minimum in mid-2027. Relevant only with a Danish CS host and a technical framing.

name: FWO Junior Postdoctoral Fellowship
eligibility: PhD ≤3 yrs before 1 Oct of the start year; supervisor at a Flemish institution
deadline_note: Closes 16 Nov 2026, 17:00 (FWO page). The deadline moved earlier from 1 Dec.
notes: Open to any nationality. KU Leuven and Ghent have AI-ethics, philosophy-of-science and computational social science groups. You need a Flemish supervisor to write a recommendation, so contact one now.

name: ANR JCJC (Young Researchers) – AAPG 2027
eligibility: Early-career coordinator hosted by a French research organisation (check the AAPG 2027 guide for PhD-date and employment rules)
deadline_note: Stage 1 of AAPG 2027 closes 13 Oct 2026, 17:00 CEST (official ANR page). Stage 2 is due around end of Mar 2027.
notes: Only realistic if you already have a French host; JCJC generally expects the coordinator to hold or be guaranteed a post at the French lab. Check the AAPG 2027 guide.

name: Ramón y Cajal (2026 call)
eligibility: PhD obtained 1 Jan 2016 – 31 Dec 2024 (2026 call, per secondary summaries)
deadline_note: Applications run 10 Nov – 10 Dec 2026, 14:00 Spanish time (BOE extract, 26 Sep 2026).
notes: Likely ineligible this round if your PhD was awarded in 2025. A later call may cover a 2025 PhD. The contract leads to a permanent post in Spain.

name: Rita Levi Montalcini Programme
funder: Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR)
eligibility: Typically PhD 3–6 yrs ago and ≥3 yrs research abroad (set per call)
deadline_note: The last call closed 15 Jan 2025 (winners announced Aug 2026), and no new call has been announced.
notes: The tenure-track route into Italy. You are not yet eligible (3+ years post-PhD required), so revisit around 2028.

name: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship
eligibility: Early-career postdocs at an eligible Irish research body
deadline_note: The 2026 call closed 23 Oct 2025, and the 2027 call had not been published at the time of checking. Earlier calls closed around Oct–Nov.
notes: Open to all disciplines and nationalities, with hosts such as Trinity or UCD. It is a short fellowship, and the next call may open at very short notice.

name: ELLIS PhD & Postdoc Program
funder: European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems
eligibility: Postdocs co-supervised by ELLIS Fellows/Members in two countries
amount: Not a central fellowship (funded via host positions)
deadline_note: There is no central postdoc fellowship deadline. ELLIS units and institutes (e.g., ELLIS Institute Finland, closed 21 Sep 2026) post positions on the ELLIS jobs board.
notes: Mainly a network and branding benefit. Watch the ELLIS jobs board for XAI and AI-safety postdocs.

name: AI2050 Early Career Fellowship
eligibility: Postdocs and pre-tenure researchers worldwide; closed nomination by partner institutions
amount: Award for a 3-year project (secondary sources cite up to ~$300k; not checked against an official page)
deadline_note: Nomination-only. In the 2026 cycle institutions nominated by 15 May 2026 and nominees applied by 13 Jul 2026. 2027 dates are unannounced but likely similar (spring nomination).
notes: A very close thematic fit (AI safety and societal risk), and it can be held at a European institution. You cannot apply yourself, so ask CMU's research office (or a future host) to nominate you in spring 2027.

name: EA Funds Transformative AI Fund
eligibility: Individuals or organisations, any country
deadline_note: Rolling: always open. This fund replaced the now-closed Long-Term Future Fund.
notes: Fast, flexible money for AI-safety and governance projects, including salary top-ups or bridge funding. It complements a main fellowship rather than replacing one.

name: Career Transition Grants (formerly Coefficient Giving Career Development & Transition Funding)
funder: BlueDot Impact (funded by Coefficient Giving, formerly Open Philanthropy)
eligibility: Individuals transitioning full-time into AI safety or biosecurity work
amount: Up to $200,000 (typically from $20k; smaller requests via Rapid Grants)
deadline_note: Rolling. Coefficient Giving handed the programme to BlueDot on 4 Sep 2026, so apply via BlueDot.
notes: Aimed at people entering AI safety rather than established academics. Could fund a bridge period or a pivot project.

name: UK AI Security Institute grants (Alignment Project / Challenge Fund / Systemic Safety)
eligibility: Researchers at UK and international academic or non-profit institutions
amount: Alignment Project up to £1M; Challenge Fund up to £200k
deadline_note: All AISI programmes were closed to applications as of Sep 2026. Watch for reopening (some sources expected the Alignment Project to reopen in summer 2026).
notes: Strong alignment with AI safety and epistemic-risk research, and international institutions are eligible. Selected teams also get compute and collaboration with AISI.

name: John Templeton Foundation grants (Intelligence Venture / Philosophy & Science)
eligibility: Researchers worldwide via their institutions
amount: Small grants ≤$234k; larger grants above that
deadline_note: The 2026 Online Funding Inquiry (OFI) closed 15 Jul 2026, and invited full proposals are due 4 Dec 2026. 2027 cycle dates will be announced early in 2027, with an OFI deadline likely in summer 2027.
notes: The Intelligence Venture ($60M+ across its funding areas) funds philosophy, cognitive science and AI work on the nature of intelligence, so metascience or epistemics of AI could fit. It suits someone who can hold a grant at a European university.

name: Research on Research Institute (RoRI) fellowships & posts
funder: Research on Research Institute (UCL / Wellcome consortium)
eligibility: PhD or equivalent; metascience focus
deadline_note: There is no standing open fellowship call. The last Research Fellow post (UCL, London) closed 9 Jul 2025, and RoRI mainly hosts externally funded fellows (e.g., UKRI AI Metascience, BA International).
notes: The natural UK home for metascience. The most realistic route is to name RoRI or UCL as host in a Leverhulme, BA, Newton or FLF application.
